div.p: Opened at the ANZ Bank Collins Street on 21 May 1985, this museum features permanent displays portraying Australia's banking heritage with particular reference to the ANZ Bank. Exhibitions have covered such subjects as money boxes, currency, gold, the Gothic Bank centenary (1987) and the 150th anniversary of banking in Melbourne (1988).
